kjv.text: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

web.text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

kjv.text: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

web.text: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

kjv.text: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

web.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kjv.text: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

web.text: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

kjv.text: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

web.text: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints,

kjv.text: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

web.text: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

kjv.text: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

web.text: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

kjv.text: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

web.text: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

kjv.text: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

web.text: yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

kjv.text: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

web.text: I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus, * Onesimus means “useful”.

kjv.text: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

web.text: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

kjv.text: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

web.text: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

kjv.text: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

web.text: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

kjv.text: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

web.text: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

kjv.text: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

web.text: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while, that you would have him forever,

kjv.text: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

web.text: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

kjv.text: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

web.text: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

kjv.text: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

web.text: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

kjv.text: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

web.text: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

kjv.text: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

web.text: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

kjv.text: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

web.text: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

kjv.text: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

web.text: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

kjv.text: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

web.text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

kjv.text: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

web.text: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

kjv.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

web.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
